args.query:
-- compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel: For each cohort of signup_date, retention at day 90 = percent of users who signed on that day and have any activity on day signup+89?
WITH signups AS (
  SELECT user_id, signup_date, channel
  FROM dim_users
  WHERE is_internal = FALSE
),
activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, active_date
  FROM fct_user_days
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT s.channel, s.signup_date, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS n_signed
  FROM signups s
  GROUP BY s.channel, s.signup_date
),
retained AS (
  SELECT s.channel, s.signup_date, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS n_retained
  FROM signups s
  JOIN activity a ON a.user_id = s.user_id AND a.active_date = date(s.signup_date + 89)
  GROUP BY s.channel, s.signup_date
)
SELECT r.channel,
       SUM(r.n_retained) AS retained_90,
       SUM(c.n_signed) AS signed,
       CASE WHEN SUM(c.n_signed)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.n_retained)::double / SUM(c.n_signed) END AS retention_90
FROM retained r
JOIN cohort c USING (channel, signup_date)
GROUP BY r.channel
ORDER BY retention_90 DESC;
